title: Clipboard ambush!
text: A cheerful person in a tabard steps into your path. 'Got two minutes for the whales?'

success.text: You now support whales monthly. You feel weirdly good.
'Sorry, it's my nan.' Flawless.

fail.text: Your phone rings for real mid-fake call. Twenty minutes on whales.

success.text: You're gone before they finish 'Hi there!'.

title: Pigeon heist!
text: A one-footed pigeon eyes your chips. It has done this before.

success.text: You and the pigeon both eat. Peace in our time.
The pigeon backs off. You are the alpha.

fail.text: It takes a chip and maintains eye contact.

success.text: Chips intact. Dignity mostly intact.

fail.text: You trip. The pigeon eats well tonight.

title: Lost tourist
text: Someone holding a paper map asks for 'the Big Ben' and is facing exactly the wrong way.

success.text: They take a selfie with you. You're in an album in another country now.
'Jubilee to Westminster.' They look at you like a wizard.

fail.text: You get confused halfway. Now you're both lost.

success.text: Somewhere over there, probably. Good luck.

title: Busker duet
text: The busker hands you the mic mid-chorus and the crowd turns to look at you.

success.text: The whole platform claps. Someone films it.

fail.text: You forgot the words to Wonderwall. Everyone knows the words to Wonderwall.

success.text: They nod. Professional courtesy.

title: Sudden downpour
text: The sky opens. Nobody has an umbrella except the man selling them for £5.

success.text: It turns inside-out on the first gust but you're dryish.
You find the one dry doorway in London.

fail.text: The doorway was a bus stop. The bus splashed you.

success.text: Soaked. Free. Very British.

title: Someone hears your accent
text: 'Wait, are you {demonym}?' A stranger lights up. 'My family's from there too!'

success.text: Ten minutes later you've swapped numbers and they've recommended a place for {dish}.

fail.text: You both get emotional about {dish}. Worth it.

success.text: A small nod. Two people far from home.

title: Signal failure
text: 'Due to a signal failure at Baker Street…' The carriage sighs as one.

choices.label: Chat to the stranger next to you

success.text: You break the unbreakable rule. They're lovely, actually.

fail.text: They put their headphones in. Fair.

success.text: Six people tut back. Solidarity.

title: Card machine's down
text: 'Cash only, sorry love.' You haven't held a coin since 2019.

choices.label: Charm your way to an IOU

success.text: 'Go on then, pay me next time.' Trust restored in humanity.

fail.text: They politely point at the cashpoint. It charges £2.

success.text: Your stomach files a complaint.
